ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution exceeding 95% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) highlights localized to circular rosettes and thin trailing edge fringes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular ring clusters (rosettes) located medially and distally on the right lobe; sparse high-intensity pixel spotting on the left lobe; concentrated white intensity at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with sharp convergence; base partially obscured by high-velocity water spray (turbulent white pixels).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular jaggedness across the entire trailing edge boundary; peak-to-valley variance is maximal at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning to a sharp distal sweep with significant terminal texture.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular rings (approximately 6-8 distinct features) ranging from 10-30 pixels in diameter, primarily clustered on the right lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular serration and probable barnacle colonization at both the left and right distal tips, resulting in a bulbous, highly textured profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced calcified-appearing clusters visible on the outer-most lateral edges of both fluke lobes.
